title: Chapter 64 Communication Network
content:
Chapter 64 Communication Network

The requirement of sending 20,000 troops for the first time just coincided with Wu Qing's idea. The Zerg and the five territories sent out the real elites. There was no need to worry about this.

As for whether the Tengu clan would deliberately make things difficult after sending out such a lineup, it depended on their temperament.

"Also, the big battle is about to begin, and time is very tight. It would be best if the first batch of troops could be sent out tomorrow."

The Rat Clan lord conveyed the time requirements of the Tengu clan.

"Okay, tomorrow morning, you need the Tengu clan to send someone to pick us up, and we will set off tomorrow."

Wu Qing had no objection to this point.

Wu Qing agreed so readily that the Rat Clan lord had no use for some of the remarks he had prepared. He stood there for a while, with nothing to say.

"Have you finished talking? Get out if you're done!"

Meng was standing aside, and seeing that the Rat Clan lord didn't speak, he was about to drive him away.

The Rat Clan leader was very afraid of Meng. When he heard Meng chasing people away, he hurriedly said, "I'm done. I'm leaving now!"

He felt that this place had become a den of dragons and tigers. Now that the mission was completed, he also wanted to leave quickly. After saying the last sentence, he turned around and left quickly.

The matter of the Tengu Clan was resolved, and the formal joining ceremony would be held next.

This world is in danger, and many rituals are very simple. Meng only made very simple arrangements for the establishment and joining ceremony of the alliance.

There is a simple altar in Meng's mansion. He asked people to put offerings for the heaven on it. Everyone recited the oath of joining the alliance under the altar, bowed to the heaven nine times, and the ceremony was completed.

Although the etiquette is simple, the oath of bowing to the heaven nine times together is a very solemn oath. Under normal circumstances, most people will not violate such an oath.

According to Wu Qing's understanding, the heaven here is the will of the world. The world has become like this now, which shows that the will of the world is very active. If such an oath is violated, there may really be bad consequences.

After the formal oath, the relationship between the lords in the alliance became closer, and everyone suddenly no longer felt lonely.

This feeling is completely different from the feeling of being a vassal of other territories. In this alliance, no matter how strong or weak the territory is, at least on the surface, everyone's status is equal.

This is actually very important. In such a living environment, these lords still insist on not becoming vassals of the Tengu clan. There is still some pride in their bones.

Although the ceremony of joining the alliance is simple, it is really important, which makes everyone feel a certain sense of belonging to the alliance.

After the ceremony of joining the alliance, Meng arranged a sumptuous lunch. After lunch, everyone discussed some details of the development and management of the alliance.

In this regard, Hu Wei has the most experience, so Meng asked him to preside over it.

Everyone expressed their opinions and put forward many valuable opinions. Those opinions that can reach a consensus immediately will be written into the charter of the alliance, and those that cannot reach a consensus will be left for discussion later.

Regardless of identity and status, everyone found the feeling of being the master in the alliance.

This was the result of Wu Qing's persuasion to Meng. As long as it did not involve fundamental interests, it could be dealt with through this brainstorming method.

The real key issue is that the five territories have the most say. Those who can become lords still understand the basic human relations and will not be those who do not understand their identities and act recklessly.

When talking about the information transmission between the territories, Wu Qing found that there were not many truly effective long-distance communication methods here.

The bear goblins all transmit simple information remotely by firing flares, and the communication methods of these independent territories can be imagined.

Meng knew that Wu Qing had a communication method that was beneficial to him, but this method was too sensitive, so he never asked.

When a lord raised this question, he deliberately looked at Wu Qing to see if Wu Qing had any ideas.

With effective communication methods, it will be of great significance to a loose organization like the alliance.

Meng also understood that this method was of extraordinary value and was very easy to attract prying eyes. If Wu Qing did not say it himself, he would never mention it.

After a discussion, everyone could not come up with an efficient solution.

"I have a very efficient communication method here, but it involves the secrets of the Zerg. If everyone can swear by the Heavenly Dao to keep the secrets for the Zerg, I am willing to share this method."

When everyone was at a loss and Meng thought Wu Qing would not mention this matter, Wu Qing suddenly spoke out.

"Okay! I swear by the Heavenly Dao! I am willing to keep the secrets for the Zerg forever! If I break this oath! I am willing to receive the cruelest punishment in the world!"

Meng did not hesitate and was the first to take the lead in swearing to the Heavenly Dao, which is also a way of saying heaven.

Through his contact with Wu Qing and the Zerg, he keenly discovered that Wu Qing and the Zerg's origins were very mysterious and had many secrets. His oath was a one-time guarantee to Wu Qing that what he saw would never be spread without permission.

With Meng's lead, other lords could only swear by this oath, which was considered to be an insurance for the various secrets of the Zerg in advance within the alliance.

However, Wu Qing did not really believe that everyone would abide by this oath. The backgrounds of the lords in this alliance were still too complicated. The secrets that the Zerg did not want to reveal would never be revealed.

"Thank you for your trust!"

"It is not necessary to ask everyone to swear an oath. Everyone should know that long-distance communication is of great significance and can easily lead to disaster. We have to guard against it."

Seeing that everyone had sworn an oath, Wu Qing began to talk about the alliance communication system with the Zerg host as the core.

"There is a branch of the Zerg, which we call the host. Their mental power is very powerful and they can fly in the air for a long time."

"They can communicate with each other through spiritual power within a certain distance."

"This kind of information exchange is fast and accurate, and can transmit a lot of very complex information in a very short time."

"My idea is that each territory of the alliance will have a resident Zerg host, and we will uniformly number these hosts."

"When you need to transfer information, you only need to tell the host the information and the territory to which the information is to be transferred, and the host can contact the host with the corresponding number and transfer the information."

"The host that receives the information then conveys the information to the destination territory."

"We can also transmit one to many, and one to many. As long as we have such an information transmission network, the efficiency of information transmission in various complex situations can become extremely efficient."

"That's why the Zerg are able to transmit information quickly."

"What do you think of the alliance adopting this method of communication?"

After Wu Qing finished speaking, he asked everyone for their opinions.

"Does the Zerg have such a magical branch? If such a communication network can be built, then the territories of the alliance, which were originally just like scattered sand, can be condensed into a whole!"

"This is so important to the development of the alliance!"

"Of course we agree!"

When Hu Wei heard about this method of communication, he immediately discovered its huge value.

Other lords can also see the value in this, and their recognition of Wu Qing and the Zerg's transcendent status in the alliance has once again deepened.
